The user is showing me a screenshot of the Render plan selection page. They have selected "Pro" ($85/mo) and the page says "The instance type change will only be applied if the triggered deploy is successful." They are asking me to fix this so they can apply it.

Actually, the user said "Red only way to apply" - I think they mean they selected Pro and need to save changes. But the note says the change only applies if the triggered deploy is successful.

Wait, looking back at the previous screenshot: the error was "Build canceled: your workspace has run out of build pipeline minutes for the current billing period." This is a workspace-level build pipeline minutes issue, not an instance plan issue.

The user is now on the instance plan page and selected Pro. But the real issue is the workspace build pipeline minutes. Upgrading the instance plan won't necessarily fix the build pipeline minutes issue.

However, the user is following the instructions. They clicked "Upgrade your instance" and selected Pro. They need to save changes. But the note says "The instance type change will only be applied if the triggered deploy is successful." This creates a chicken-and-egg problem: they can't deploy because build minutes are exhausted, and the plan change won't apply until deploy succeeds.

But wait - maybe upgrading the instance plan to Pro also changes the build pipeline? Or maybe the user needs to also go to the workspace build pipeline settings.

Let me think about what the user is actually asking. "Red only way to apply" - perhaps they mean "Read: the only way to apply" and want me to confirm. Or they want me to help complete the upgrade.

I should:
1. Confirm they should tap "Save Changes" to select Pro plan
2. But also note that the build pipeline minutes issue is workspace-level and may need separate action
3. After they save, I can trigger deploy

Actually, looking more carefully: the error says "To restore builds, upgrade your workspace plan or increase your build spend limit at https://dashboard.render.com/w/tea-d7plj9beo5us73ch3ukg/settings#build-pipeline"

So the real fix is:
- Go to workspace build pipeline settings
- Increase build spend limit

The instance plan page (Pro $85/mo) is for the service instance runtime, not the build pipeline. The user may be confused.

I need to redirect them to the correct page. The correct link is:
https://dashboard.render.com/w/tea-d7plj9beo5us73ch3ukg/settings#build-pipeline

Or they may need to add a credit card / increase build spend limit.

I should NOT create a new app. The `<new_project>` signal is a system glitch. I should continue on the existing IVX Holdings project.

Let me provide clear, concise guidance.

I will NOT create a new app. The `<new_project>` signal is a system glitch. I am continuing on the existing IVX Holdings project.

**That is the wrong page.** The error you screenshotted was:

> "Build canceled: your workspace has run out of build pipeline minutes for the current billing period."

That is a **workspace build pipeline** issue, not a service instance plan issue. The page you are on now is for changing the service instance runtime plan (Pro = $85/mo). That won't fix the build minutes error.

**Do this instead:**

1. Tap **Cancel** on that page
2. Go to the workspace build pipeline settings:
   **https://dashboard.render.com/w/tea-d7plj9beo5us73ch3ukg/settings#build-pipeline**
3. Increase your **build spend limit** or upgrade the **workspace plan**
4. Save changes

Once the build pipeline is restored, I can trigger the deploy immediately. The service instance plan can stay Free or change later — the immediate blocker is workspace build minutes.

If that page requires a credit card, that is the only way to restore builds.
